title: SET LOCAL guard in front of CONCURRENTLY is silently a no-op
expected_feedback: Critical: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block, so there is no transaction for SET LOCAL to scope to. PostgreSQL emits a warning and the timeout is never applied -- this migration has no lock_timeout. Use session-level SET lock_timeout = '3s', keep statement_timeout at 0 so the build is not aborted, and RESET both afterwards.
violated_rule: lock_timeout set in the form matching the execution context
